# Transitions

Fourteen transitions in four groups, named for what the person sees. Pick one by the relationship between the two screens.

**Kind:** Foundation

**Storybook page:** `design-system/src/styles/MotionTransitions.mdx`

## Reading this page

To tell the Between places transitions apart, look at the Breadcrumb:

- It gets longer or shorter: **Drill into and climb back out**.
- It stays the same length while your place in an ordered set changes: **Step to the next or previous**.
- Tabs change: **Switch views**.
- It is replaced by an unrelated one: **Go to another area**.

In running text, Drill, Step and Go to stand for the full names. Tokens drop the `motion.` prefix (`spatial.fast`); their values live on [Physics](?path=/docs/foundations-expression-motion-physics--docs). Per-component motion lives in each component's Motion section.

## Between places

The person ends up somewhere else. Each transition in this group starts from a small tree of screens: where you were, and where you land.

### Go to another area

| Tells the person | When | Not | Breadcrumb | PLUS case |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| This is a different area; nothing here relates to where you were. | Moving between Sidebar areas (Sessions to Tutors). | If the new view sits inside the current one, it is Drill. | Replaced. | Sidebar click, browser back. |

| What | Property | Token | Starts |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Sidebar highlight | position | `spatial.fast` | 0 |
| Old page | opacity out | `appearance.fast` | 0 |
| New page | opacity in, in place, all at once | `appearance.default` | After the clean-fade gap |

Never a slide (which suggests the areas sit side by side) and never a cut. The Sidebar itself does not move.

### Drill into and climb back out

| Tells the person | When | Not | Breadcrumb | PLUS case |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| You went one level deeper, and the way back is the way you came. | Opening one record or item from a list, card or overview, or opening a focused task. | A quick look that leaves the page in place is Open an overlay. | Gains a level going in, loses one coming back. A focused task has no Breadcrumb; it still counts as a Drill. | Session row in a tutor’s record; Log a session. Triggered by a row or button, the Breadcrumb, browser back. |

| What | Property | Token | Starts |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Tapped row | grows into the record (position, size, corner radius together) | `spatial.default` | 0 |
| The row's own content | opacity out | `appearance.fast` | 0 |
| List | fades out in place; it doesn't move, and nothing dims | `appearance.fast` | 0 |
| Record header, tabs and content | opacity in, together, in place | `appearance.default` | Once the container is well on its way |

The row becomes the page: its own bars fade as it grows, and the record's content fades in once the container shows where it is going. Nothing inside travels; the container is the only mover. Because people drill many times a day, the grow runs on `spatial.default`, and Back reverses it one speed faster on `spatial.fast`, returning the list at the same scroll position with that row briefly lit.

PLUS is at most three levels deep (area, record, one record inside it), so the same container transform holds at every level. A flow that needs a fourth level is a hierarchy to flatten, not a fourth grow. On a desktop with a fixed Sidebar a page never slides in: a slide reads as a floating Panel opening.

Climbing back one level shrinks the page into the row it came from. Jumping back two or more levels, past a page no longer on screen, fades in place with the Breadcrumb already shorter.

**Focused task.** Opening a focused task (Log a session) replaces the frame itself: the page and Sidebar fade out together on `appearance.fast`, then Frame · focused fades in on `appearance.default`. A button, a row's menu item or a link all open the task the same way, because the frame changes, not the thing pressed. Moving between steps is Step; leaving with unsaved work confirms in a Modal, then reverses one speed faster. Finishing carries on forward to the new record and a Flag confirms.

**Used in:** Record page, Table rows, PatternCard, Breadcrumb, focused tasks.

### Switch views

| Tells the person | When | Not | Breadcrumb | PLUS case |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| The same thing, seen another way. | Page tabs, such as a session’s Overview, Notes and Reflection. | An ordered set is Step; pill filters and format switches are Swap content in place. | Unchanged. | Tab bar click or arrow keys. |

| What | Property | Token | Starts |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Tab indicator | position, width | `spatial.fast` | 0 |
| Both tab bodies | slide together toward the chosen tab, as one flat sheet, no fade | `spatial.slow` for a page-size body, `spatial.default` for a panel | 0 |
| Tab labels | color | `appearance.fast` | 0 |

Because the views are peers in a row, the bodies move sideways as a group without fading; in Reduced mode the slide becomes an `appearance.fast` fade.

### Step to the next or previous

| Tells the person | When | Not | Breadcrumb | PLUS case |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| The next one in line, and where you are in the set. | An ordered set: form steps, paging, one week to the next, reflection questions. | Going deeper is Drill; another area is Go to. | Unchanged; position label changes ("2 of 4"). | Reflection 1 of 4; Schedule week to week. Triggered by Next and Back, arrow keys, swipe on touch. |

| Steps sit | Body | Token |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Across the top (horizontal ProgressTracker, ≤4 steps, paging, Schedule weeks, Carousel) | Old and new slide together sideways, no fade | By size; step states change in place on appearance.fast |
| Down a side (vertical ProgressTracker, ≥5 steps, reflection questions in a side list) | Old and new slide together vertically, no fade: Next brings the new step up from below | By size; step states change in place on appearance.fast |

The body moves on the same axis as the step list. Step states change in place on `appearance.fast`, the moment the body starts: the step just left becomes visited and the next becomes current, and nothing travels along the ProgressTracker. Placement (top for four steps or fewer, side for five or more) is set once, when the task opens, by the longest path the flow can take, so a branch never changes the slide axis mid-task. Fit can push top to side, never the reverse: four steps whose labels would truncate go down the side. The position label swaps on `appearance.fast`; the header, Sidebar and step list never move.

**Used in:** Form steps, Table paging, Schedule weeks, Carousel, focused tasks.

## Within a place

The person stays where they are; something on the page changes.

### Scroll to a spot on the page

| Tells the person | When | Not | PLUS case |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| You’re still on this page; here is the spot. | A heading outline link or a link to one comment on the current page. | Another page is Go to or Drill. | Heading outline "Escalation" link scrolls and marks the heading. |

| What | Property | Token | Starts |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Page | scroll position | `spatial.slow` | 0 |
| Destination | Call attention (below) | as Call attention | On arrival |

In Reduced mode the page does not travel: the content at the new position fades in on `appearance.fast` and the destination is marked.

### Swap content in place

| Tells the person | When | Not | PLUS case |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| The frame is the same; what’s inside it changed. | A view pill, a filter that replaces most of a list, a confirm replacing a form in a Modal, Previous/Next in a Panel. | If one item changes, it is Add or remove, or Update a value. | Sessions filter from This week to Last month. |

| What | Property | Token | Starts |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Frame, headers, stable labels | stay still | — | — |
| Selected view pill fill | glides to the new pill | `spatial.fast` | 0 |
| Old content | opacity out | `appearance.fast` | 0 |
| New content | opacity in | `appearance.fast` | After the clean-fade gap |

The old content is gone before the new arrives, so one clean frame sits between them. A cross-fade shows both at half strength and reads as mud.

### Add or remove an item

| Tells the person | When | Not | PLUS case |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| One thing joined or left, and the others made room. | One item joins or leaves a list or grid in the page (rows, SectionMessage, Banner). | Above the page is Open an overlay; replacing most of a list is Swap content. | Adding a session; opening a record adds it to Sidebar open items. |

| What | Property | Token | Starts |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Rows below | make room | `spatial.fast` | 0 |
| New row | opens from the seam (height) | `spatial.fast` | 0 |
| New row content | opacity in, in place, no scale | `appearance.fast` | Once there is room |
| Removed row | opacity out | `appearance.fast` | 0 |
| Rows below a removed row | close the gap | `spatial.fast` | As it fades |

In a grid, the others slide along their row and wrap.

### Reorder items

| Tells the person | When | Not | PLUS case |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| The same items, in a new order. | Sorting, or dragging an item to a new place in the same set. | If items join or leave, it is Add or remove. | Sorting Students by last session; dragging a session to another slot. |

| What | Property | Token | Starts |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Each item | moves to its new place: straight along the column in a list, x then y in a grid | `spatial.default` | Staggered: 20 ms apart, or 500 ms ÷ items if shorter |

A dragged item follows the pointer by weight (`spatial.fast` for a Tag, `spatial.default` for a card) and settles on `spatial.fast` from the release velocity while neighbors close up on `spatial.default`. With the keyboard, Space picks up the grab handle, arrow keys move it (including across lists), Space drops it and Escape cancels, and a live region says where it is. Between two lists the dropped item takes the place it lands on and both lists close up. Under Reduced motion nothing travels: what moved fades in place on `appearance.fast`, in the same order.

### Expand and collapse

| Tells the person | When | Not | PLUS case |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| More of the same thing, revealed from where it was hidden. | A disclosure row, Search icon opening into a field, Filter button widening for its count. | If new content arrives from elsewhere, it is Load content. | "Escalate this session" reveals the reason field. |

| What | Property | Token | Starts |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Container | height, from the seam | `spatial.fast` for a row, `spatial.default` for a section | 0 |
| Rows below | move down | Same as the container | 0 |
| Revealed content | opacity in | `appearance.fast` | Once there is room |
| Chevron | rotates with the height | Same as the container | 0 |

Closing reverses the reveal on the same token, with the detail fading first.

### Load content

| Tells the person | When | Not | PLUS case |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Something is coming, and the page won’t jump when it arrives. | Content is fetched, then arrives. | Saving is Update a value or state. | The Admin dashboard loading. |

| Wait | Signal |
| --- | --- |
| Under 200 ms | Nothing |
| 200 ms to 5 s | A Skeleton or Spinner, inside the thing that is loading |
| In a menu or Popup | Never a Skeleton: one "Loading options" row, then "Couldn't load options" with Retry. New options fade in 20 ms apart; the list grows on spatial.fast |
| Over 5 s | Progress with a number |

| What | Property | Token | Starts |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Skeleton | shimmer, top-left to bottom-right | `linear` | While waiting |
| Content | opacity in, in place, in load order | `appearance.default` | Staggered: 20 ms apart, or 500 ms ÷ items if shorter |
| Skeleton | opacity out under it | `appearance.fast` | As content arrives |

A button that starts a load keeps its width: its label fades out, a Spinner fades in, and the same button confirms when done.

## Above a place

Something joins the page from above or beside it.

### Open and close an overlay

| Tells the person | When | Not | PLUS case |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| This sits on top for now; the page underneath is untouched. | A Modal, Popup, floating Panel, Flag or Tooltip appears. | Taking space beside the page is Dock and undock; a deeper Breadcrumb level is Drill. | Call-off confirm Modal: Cancel reverses, Confirm carries on. |

| Component | Enter | Exit |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Modal | scales up from 96% and fades in; the Blanket dims | scales to 98% and fades |
| Popup, FilterMenu | clips open from the trigger's top-right corner along one axis | fades |
| Floating Panel | slides in from its edge over the page, with no Blanket | slides back to the same edge and stays there |
| Flag | slides in from the top-right corner | leaves the way it came, by the exit rules in Physics |
| Tooltip | fades in after a short wait | fades out shortly after the pointer leaves |

A Modal opens only from user action, moves focus to its first input as the motion starts, and never stacks a second Modal (a confirm swaps content in place). Scale is for floating layers only.

Product examples for Popup opening and Flag queue stacking live on [Popup](?path=/docs/components-overlays-and-layering-popup--docs) and [Flag](?path=/docs/components-messaging-flag--docs).

Cancel plays the entrance backward, one speed faster, and nothing else changes. Confirm fades the Modal, recolors the row's status and brings a Flag in.

### Dock and undock a panel

| Tells the person | When | Not | PLUS case |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| This sits beside your work, and your work made room for it. | A panel takes space beside the page. | Floating above the page is Open an overlay. | The AI Panel docks on the right of Sessions and the table narrows. |

| What | Property | Token | Starts |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Page | width, making room | `spatial.slow` | 0 |
| Panel | slides in from its edge | `spatial.slow` | 0 |
| Panel content | opacity in | `appearance.fast` | When the page is about 90% done making room |

Below the docking width the Panel slides over with a Blanket.

## Feedback

Nothing moves place. One element answers, or asks to be looked at.

### Update a value or state

| Tells the person | When | Not | PLUS case |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| This value changed. | A status, Saving to Saved, or a count. | If the element joins or leaves, it is Add or remove. | Shift swap accepted: session goes from Called off to Covered. |

| What | Property | Token | Starts |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Status | color | `appearance.default` | 0 |
| Number, first view | rolls once | `spatial.fast` | 0 |
| Number, later updates | fades to the new value | `appearance.fast` | 0 |

A number never overshoots.

### Call attention

| Tells the person | When | PLUS case |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Look here. | The row you jumped to, a warning that appeared, a field that needs fixing. | Scroll to "Escalation" marks the heading. |

| What | Property | Token | Starts |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Spot | highlight in | `appearance.fast` | 0 |
| Spot | highlight out | `appearance.slow` | After a 500 ms hold |

It plays once: repeating motion belongs to loading, never to attention. Color, icon and message always carry the meaning, so Reduced mode loses nothing.

| Error case | When it shows | What moves | Shake |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Leaving a field | When focus leaves it; once red, it rechecks while typing | The message makes room, then fades in; it clears the moment the field is fixed | No |
| Typing | Never before the field is left; a code only when complete | Nothing | No |
| Submitting a Modal | On submit, for a required field never touched | The Modal stays open; the bad fields are marked; focus goes to the first | The Modal, once |
| A field with its own button | On submit, for a server-only check such as a join code | The field is marked, its message below | The field and button, once |
| Submitting a page | On submit | A one-line summary makes room at the top; focus goes to the first error | No |
| The system failed | After sending fails | A message makes room at the top of the form | No: the person did nothing wrong |
| Wrong again | Each submit | The same as the first time; after a few tries, the message offers help | The same shake, never bigger |

Prevent errors first: use pickers, dropdowns, radios and number inputs with limits wherever the value has a fixed set or range, and keep submit enabled until the form is sent so people act, then see exactly what to fix. One shake at most, however many fields are wrong, and errors make no sound. In Reduced mode there is no shake: color, icon, message, the focus move and a screen-reader announcement carry it.

In a field, check when focus leaves and never flag the person while they type.

A failure that is the system's gets a message that makes room, never a shake.

A page gets a summary at the top and focus on the first error, never a shake.
